findings.documented: Returns a field named 'token' in the response
findings.actual: Returns a field named 'access_token' instead; also returns 'refresh_token' and 'refresh_url'
findings.how_found: Tested login flow with demo credentials and inspected the response structure
findings.impact: Frontend code must normalize 'access_token' to 'token' for internal consistency, or update all token references

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns market insights and statistics
findings.actual: Endpoint returns 404 Not Found when called with valid bearer token and API key
findings.how_found: Attempted to fetch insights data from the documented endpoint
findings.impact: Insights screen cannot display documented analytics; must be calculated from live listings instead

findings.actual: Uses 'offset' and 'limit' parameters; response includes 'offset', 'returned', 'has_more' fields
findings.how_found: Attempted pagination with page parameter; received 404. Tested with offset parameter; received data
findings.impact: Pagination must use offset-based approach; page number must be calculated from offset

findings.documented: Price fields are in Indian Rupees (INR)
findings.actual: Price fields (price_min, price_max, price) are in crores; must multiply by 10,000,000 for INR
findings.how_found: Compared project prices with rental prices; noticed project prices were 10 million times larger when converted
findings.impact: All project prices must be multiplied by 10,000,000 for display in INR
